model.name: Orbital Economy v7.6.1 r1 — Energy Kernel v2, Mode 25 calibrated to a 50% resource-supply shock

v7.6 r2.result: accepted 2026-09-25; superseded by v7.6.1 r1 (Mode 25 calibration)

v7.6 r1.result: runtime FAIL (algebraic loop in Modes 25-26); superseded by r2, see docs/V7_6_R1_TO_R2_FIX_REPORT.md

canonical_platform.rule: docs/VERSIONING_AND_AUTHORITY.md section 8 — bit-exact numbers are defined on this platform only
canonical_platform.verify: cd lab && node --expose-gc src/cli.js series --modes=all --out=output/series && cd .. && node tools/verify_series.mjs lab/output/series/series-digest.json
canonical_platform.reason: the model's ^ runs as Math.pow; Node's Math.pow rounds differently on Windows and Linux for some arguments (docs/tasks/006-cross-os/ACCEPTANCE_RU.md)

validation.change: one new Mode 25 check: A Energy Supply min over days 360-720 >= 400 (rationed, not cut off)

energy_kernel_v2.resource_consumption_identity: Power Resource Consumption = Energy Supply × Power Resource per Energy (checked in Modes 25-26; the flow is switch-gated)
energy_kernel_v2.price_channel: X Power Resource Price reads X Perceived Power Resource Fulfillment (coverage of the smoothed X Energy Demand Signal); the physical rationing ratio X Power Resource Fulfillment is not in the price path — see docs/V7_6_R1_TO_R2_FIX_REPORT.md
energy_kernel_v2.mode25_calibration: Power Resource Shock Factor = 0.5 since v7.6.1 (0.1 before): impact-matched to the Mode 26 capacity control; see docs/V7_6_1_CALIBRATION_REPORT.md

regression.design: only the value of Power Resource Shock Factor changed; the constant acts only in Mode 25
regression.result: 26 × common=1004, changed=1 (the constant's own series, 0.1 -> 0.5), every other series identical; Mode 25: 639 series changed by design
regression.change_policy: docs/model_v7_6_1/change-policy-v7.6.1-mode25-calibration.json (r1.1): POLICY RESULT PASS, 667 expected events, unexpected 0, forbidden 0, required missing 0

previous.design: exact algebraic fallback under Power Resource Enabled=0

authority: Accepted code wins; documentation in docs/ is aligned to this model as of 2026-09-25.

repository.layout: repo root is the accepted baseline; earlier baselines are commits and tags, not directories

reference.purpose: exact regression base for Modes 0-24 and 26
